_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and sizes the one sensor. experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. The support-line teacher: FirstAid early, Revive much later. ⚑ Q4 SHAPE (conversation-journal §4.6, R1): the old opener was a nameless multi-grant option — a wall of greyed skill rows as the first thing a player saw. Now: greeting at root, teachings behind one row as named one-grant rows.
name: VillageHealer

lines: Rest by the fire and regain your strength.
Start with yourself. The rest follows.

grants.line: You are hurt. Here — learn to patch yourself up, you will need it out there.
Let me teach you how to aid your fallen comrades and bring them back to life.
